prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square beFood restaurant promotion poster. Use a bright sky-blue background with fluffy clouds, a city skyscraper on the left, and a cathedral facade on the right. At the top center place the white beFood wordmark and the D'ran logo badge. Add a large blue title 'Nem Nướng D'ran'. Below it place two yellow ticket-shaped promo boxes reading 'Giảm đến 50%' and 'Giao không ghép đơn'. In the center, show a large photoreal bamboo basket platter filled with grilled pork rolls, cucumber slices, herbs, lettuce, carrot strips, noodles, and rice-paper pieces, resting on a light wooden round table. Technical style: photoreal food advertising poster with composited landmark scenery, bright daylight food photography lighting, fresh appetizing finish, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
